title: Hexagravity

sections.title: About Hexagravity
text: Hexagon tower world of geometry platformer game. Every new world is a new game! Make your way between dangers jumping in this amazing platformer and rhythmic action game! Be prepare for a near impossible challenge in this hexagon tower world of geometry. Test your skills as you battle your way jumping through dangerous passages and spiky obstacles. Every new world is a new game!!!
